highlights: Practice keeps one steady layout: the circuit stays whole and in place, with Formulas on the left and the calculator on the right.
Keyboard play works throughout: Enter after a set, keys 1-4 in the final test, typing after the calculator closes, and Page Up and Page Down to scroll.
The upright calculator is easier to type in: exponents end where you expect, operators stay in their box, and a new ×10ⁿ key.
Loops and nodes explains node counting one node per line and says what an ideal supply does where it is used.
The X-ray tube problem gives the kinetic-energy step, and the Voltage and energy topic opens with a one-step problem.
Several wrong answers and false statements in problems are fixed.
